notes: This is al-Saduq's statement of his routes («طرق») to the book of Hisham b. al-Hakam, with no saying (rule 11); each group is one route, stopping before Hisham
«رضي الله عنهما» and «و كنيته أبو محمد ...» are blessing and description, not links
«أبي» is al-Saduq's father, named only by relation
